name: jyothisgeorge.com UAT: Dr George review (Nov 2026)
instructions:
What this round is
Dr George reviewed the website and asked for changes. Ralfiz has made them on the test site. Check each change is there and works, on a laptop and on your phone.

Where
• Website: https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev (no login).
• Content manager: https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/admin/ (your own login, from Jobin). Only the content manager section needs it.

Order
1. Getting started: everyone.
2. Then your own section: Sana: Home and About, and the content manager checks. Bishara: Publications and Thought leadership. Mithra: Board, Contact and Privacy.
3. Everyone: Whole site.

Rules
• Pages now have short addresses: /about, /publications, /thought-leadership, /board, /contact, /privacy. Old .html links should forward there.
• Content manager checks change the shared test site. Only Sana does them, and puts everything back straight after.
• Do NOT send the contact form. It emails Dr George.
• Tests tagged "Waiting on Dr George": check they work. The wording may still change after he replies.
• Never delete or rewrite real content.

How to mark
• Pass: it matches "Should happen".
• Fail: it doesn't. Write what you did and saw, add a screenshot.
• Blocked: you couldn't test it (error page, no login, no phone).

tests.title: Open the test site
steps: On a laptop in Chrome, open https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev.
On your own phone, open the same address.
tests.expected: The home page opens on both, with the quote, the portrait and the menu. No "coming soon" page.

tests.title: Read what changed
steps: Go back to the plan's main page: click Back, or open My Tasks and then this plan (not a section).
Open the panel called "How to test" (click it to expand) and read it.
tests.expected: You know which sections are yours (Sana: Home and About, and the content manager checks; Bishara: Publications and Thought leadership; Mithra: Board, Contact and Privacy; everyone: Whole site), and that this round checks the changes from Dr George's review.

tests.title: Name and roles under the quote
steps: Open the home page on a computer and on a phone.
tests.expected:
Under the quote: "DR JYOTHIS THOMAS GEORGE" and three lines: Chief Medical Officer, Rezera / Visiting Professor of Cardiometabolic Medicine, University of Oxford / Founder, CardioMetabolic Health Foundation.
(Why: Review: who he is should be clear on the first screen.)

tests.title: Job title on each career stop
tests.expected:
Each stop shows its title: Clinical training & PhD, Senior Clinical Researcher, Global Head, Clinical Development, Corporate Vice President, VP & Therapeutic Area Head, Chief Medical Officer. Nothing overlaps on a phone.
(Why: Review: show the job title on the timeline.)

tests.title: Career stop opens the right role on About
tests.expected:
Opens https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/about#career-r4 with the Amgen role shown and the timeline in view.
(Why: Plan: links from Home keep working after the About rebuild.)

tests.title: Portrait appears straight away
steps: Reload the home page, ideally on a phone on mobile data.
tests.expected:
The portrait appears with the rest of the first screen, not as an empty white frame.
(Why: Plan (images): portrait was 524 KB, now 188 KB, loaded first.)

tests.title: All six roles are in the page itself
steps: Open the page, press Ctrl+U (Cmd+Option+U on a Mac) to view the source, and search for "Novo Nordisk", then "University of Edinburgh".
tests.expected:
Both are found, with their full role text and impact lists.
(Why: Review: search engines and LinkedIn should read the full career, not only what scripts draw.)

tests.title: Switching roles works
steps: Use the ← → buttons inside a role.
Tab to a stop and use the keyboard arrow keys.
tests.expected:
The chosen role shows and the others hide. ← goes to the earlier role, → to the later one. Rezera is shown first.
(Why: Plan: same behaviour as before the rebuild.)

tests.title: Phone: role bar and swipe
steps: On a phone, scroll to Career.
Use the arrows in the bar under the dots, then swipe left and right on the role card.
tests.expected:
The bar names the role (e.g. "Amgen · 2022 – 2025 · 5 / 6") and the card changes with it.
(Why: Plan: keep the phone controls working.)

tests.title: Grammar fixes in each role
steps: Open each role and read its text.
tests.expected:
Rezera: "both trials completed on time", "Delivered a JACC publication alongside an EAS presentation". Boehringer: "Founding steering committee member and clinical development lead". Oxford: "Global Clinical Lead for one of the first GLP-1 outcome trials", "and served as principal investigator", OCDEM written in full. Novo Nordisk: "Corporate Vice President, leading 300+ team members". Amgen: "Served on the Board of Amgen Technologies Ireland". Edinburgh: "gonadotrophin-inhibitory hormone", "characterising its function and translational potential".
(Why: Review: his wording corrections.)

tests.title: Prix Galien wording
tests.expected:
The Prix Galien card uses his highlighted wording.
(Why: Review: his highlighted wording.)

tests.title: Background section
tests.expected:
Mentions "diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular disease". The last paragraph is about the CardioMetabolic Health Foundation.
(Why: Review: add obesity and cardiovascular disease, and the Foundation.)

tests.title: Banner photo
steps: Look at the top of the page.
tests.expected:
The office photo shows clearly, not blurry or stretched.
(Why: Plan (images): banner was 1.5 MB, now 83 KB.)

tests.title: Four featured papers, nothing rotating
steps: Open the page and wait 15 seconds.
tests.expected:
The JACC paper is large and marked Latest. Three papers beside it each show a summary. No dots, no Pause button, no "More featured papers" heading, and nothing changes by itself.
(Why: Review: show all featured papers with summaries; stop the rotation.)

tests.title: JACC summary
tests.expected:
"Data showing an 82% reduction in hsCRP with oral NLRP3 inhibition, alongside reductions in IL-6, fibrinogen and Lp(a)."
(Why: Review: his correction.)

tests.title: "CV" written out
tests.expected:
Not found. The text says "cardiovascular".
(Why: Review: no abbreviations.)

tests.title: Papers linked to him for Google
steps: View the source and search for "ScholarlyArticle".
Optional: paste the page source into validator.schema.org.
tests.expected:
About 10 papers listed, each with its journal and DOI, all pointing to the same person. The validator shows no errors.
(Why: Plan: structured data (ScholarlyArticle).)

tests.title: Paper links open the right papers
steps: Click Read paper on two or three cards.
tests.expected:
Each opens the publisher page for that paper.
(Why: Phase 6 link check.)

tests.title: Interviews heading
tests.expected:
Small label "Interviews" and heading "Conversations with clinical leaders".
(Why: Review: the first section needs a proper heading.)

tests.title: J.P. Morgan line
tests.expected:
"represented Rezera at J.P. Morgan".
(Why: Review: say Rezera.)

tests.title: FT feature
steps: Find the FT box and click its link.
tests.expected:
Text reads "from the evolution of the cardiometabolic market". The link reads "Read on FT.com (subscription)" and opens the FT article.
(Why: Review: wording fix and the article link.)

tests.title: Sachs forum date
steps: Find the Sachs European Neuroscience Innovation Forum card.
tests.expected:
Shows "March 2027" (Zurich).
(Why: Review: give it a date like the others.)

tests.title: NodThera press marked "now Rezera"
steps: Look at the press list dates.
tests.expected:
Four NodThera items end in "· now Rezera".
(Why: Review: readers should see it is the same company.)

tests.title: LinkedIn cards open the matching post
steps: Check the post matches the card title, especially "residual inflammatory risk" and "healthy lifespan".
tests.expected:
Every card opens a linkedin.com/posts address (no lnkd.in) and the post matches its card.
(Why: Review: full LinkedIn addresses instead of short links.)

tests.title: "Upstream is mainstream" image
steps: Find the card in the LinkedIn section.
tests.expected:
The image shows clearly.
(Why: Plan (images): was 2 MB, now 181 KB.)

tests.title: OCDEM in full
steps: Look at the strip under the top banner.
tests.expected:
"Oxford Centre for Diabetes, Endocrinology and Metabolism".
(Why: Review: write abbreviations out the first time.)

tests.title: Board and governance appointments
steps: Scroll below the four experience cards.
tests.expected:
Heading "Board and governance appointments" and four cards: Amgen Technologies Ireland, OCDEM, CardioMetabolic Health Foundation, and trial steering committees naming 7 trials. Two columns on a computer, one on a phone.
(Why: Review: describe each board role.)

tests.title: Steering committee count
steps: Compare the number in the top strip with the trials listed in B2.
tests.expected:
Note what you see; Dr George will confirm which number is right.
(Why: Open question: the strip says 6, the card names 7 trials.)

tests.title: Closing banner opens Contact with Board roles
steps: Scroll to the end and click "Get in touch →".
tests.expected:
Banner reads "Available for select Non-Executive Director and Scientific Advisory Board mandates". The button opens https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/contact?topic=board with "Board roles" selected and the form in view.
(Why: Review: a clear call to action for board roles.)

tests.title: Intro line
steps: Read the top of the page.
tests.expected:
"Select a topic below to route your enquiry directly to Dr George’s inbox. He replies by email." appears once.
(Why: Review: the sentence appeared twice.)

tests.title: Email can be tapped, selected and copied
steps: Click the email address, then the Copy button.
tests.expected:
Clicking the address takes you to the message form. Copy shows a "Copied" message and pasting gives the full address.
(Why: Review: the email card could not be clicked.)

tests.title: Save contact card
steps: Click "Save contact card" next to Copy (and on a phone).
tests.expected:
A contact file (.vcf) downloads, or the phone offers to add the contact.
(Why: Review: "Save contact" only opened the contact page.)

tests.title: Topic links choose the topic
tests.expected:
The matching topic button is selected each time and the page scrolls to the form.
(Why: Plan: ?topic= links from other pages.)

tests.title: Visiting-card label on phones
steps: On a phone, open any page and watch the round button in the corner for 5 seconds.
tests.expected:
Its label slides out briefly, then hides again.
(Why: Review: make the card button clear on phones.)

tests.title: Sign-in cookie line
tests.expected:
Says there are no cookies except a sign-in cookie for people who manage the site.
(Why: Review: say exactly which cookie exists.)

sections.name: Whole site: addresses, privacy and phones

tests.title: Short addresses
tests.expected:
Menu goes to /about, /publications, /thought-leadership, /board, /contact. The first three forward to /about, /thought-leadership and /about. /nope shows the site's own "page not found" page.
(Why: Plan: /about instead of about.html.)

tests.title: No tracking scripts
steps: Open the browser developer tools → Network, reload a few pages, filter for "google" and "cloudflareinsights".
tests.expected:
No requests to Google Analytics, Tag Manager or Cloudflare Insights.
(Why: Review: security settings still allowed Google and Cloudflare tracking.)

tests.title: Test site hidden from Google
tests.expected:
"Disallow: /".
(Why: Plan: the test copy must never be listed.)

tests.title: Phones: nothing runs off the side
steps: On a phone, open every page and try to scroll sideways.
tests.expected:
No page scrolls sideways; text links are easy to tap.
(Why: Phase 6 check.)

sections.name: Content manager checks (one person, put everything back)

tests.title: Home sections switch in the content manager
steps: Switch the new option off, save, reload Home.
tests.expected:
Name and roles disappear when off and come back when on. Home → Top of page has editable "Name" and "Roles" fields.
(Why: Plan: new "Name and roles under the headline" switch.)

tests.title: Citation badge
steps: Content manager (https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/admin/) → Publications → Most cited → open CARMELINA, type "1,100+" in "Times cited", save, reload Publications.
tests.expected:
A small gold "1,100+ CITATIONS" badge appears on that card only, and goes when the field is cleared.
(Why: Review: show citation counts on Most cited.)

tests.title: PNG photo saved as JPEG
steps: Content manager (https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/admin/): upload a photo saved as .png into any picture field (then put the old picture back).
tests.expected:
The new picture address ends in .jpg. A logo with a transparent background stays .png.
(Why: Plan (images): stop heavy PNG photos in future.)

tests.title: Content manager changes show on the site
steps: Content manager (https://jyothisgeorge.ralfiztechnologies.workers.dev/admin/): change one word in Home → Top of page → Roles, save, reload Home.
tests.expected:
The change shows on the next reload.
(Why: Plan: everything editable still comes from the content manager.)
